name: What materials are used for cable railing posts and cables?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for cable railing posts and cables?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cable railing systems primarily use high-grade stainless steel for both the cables and posts due to its strength, durability, and corrosion resistance. Typically, 316-grade stainless steel is preferred for outdoor applications, especially in coastal regions, because of its superior resistance to saltwater corrosion compared to 304-grade. Posts can also be made from other durable materials such as aluminum or wood, often paired with stainless steel cables for a custom aesthetic. When choosing materials, consider the local environment, such as the specific weather patterns in places like Dublin or Pleasanton, to ensure long-term performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: High-grade stainless steel, typically 316 for outdoors, is used for cables and posts. Posts can also be aluminum or wood. Material choice should consider local environmental conditions.
